verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a cloud identity service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented way to opt out of Microsoft's telemetry or usage tracking. The diagnostic-settings item only covers routing a tenant's own activity logs to endpoints, which is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
